statement: All relative multiples of the actual rational cusp, their complete horizontal intrinsic class-two loci, joint images and conjugacy fibres, with exact global cusp localization and all unramified intrinsic-to-joint fibres.

notes: The full actual local origin is (u0,d^r) for every r in Z3, including zero. Every horizontal abelian input is allowed before applying the exact obstruction r[7[v,eB0]]. The three image orders are81,3,1, with all15 finite coordinates retained.

The actual universal rational correction matrix has five nonzero Hall rows. Its multiples are proved integral on the three respective solution lattices and have the literal joint image (r(m/4-p/6),-r(m/4-p/6)).

The complete joint image, all fixed geometric conjugators and finite carries are evaluated in three regimes. Source/fibre types and every coordinate inverse retain the actual Hall image and its correction.

The remaining actual handle character eta is retained in epsilon0=-p(p+eta+2)/2. Its value is not assigned; the explicit order-three kernel direction2(B1-B2) sets any required phase. All image and fibre types are independent of eta.

The rational y/z swap carries the exact tangential parameter z/x to y/x. Both genuine endpoint actions factor through the same Gamma; centre-freeness proves this for the entire path torsor. This supplies a full global cusp family with an explicit Kummer left inverse from -y/x.

The global Kummer completion is the inverse limit of discrete direct sums, hence the restricted-exponent topology is retained. Its actual localization in the basis(3,4), convergent logarithmic sum, split inverse and every fibre are proved, including the absence of finite torsion.

The actual local source comparison retains kappa4 values(b,alpha), alpha a unit. The exact matrix and inverse are displayed, and the global class(-V-br/alpha)kappa3+(r/alpha)kappa4 restricts to the actual local origin.

The entire unramified-outside3 N2-to-joint map is onto with imageZ3^3 x C3^2 and fibresZ3^27 x C3^11 x C9^5. Full N fibres use the actual E41 truncation and recursive Hall corrections, giving the product with all higher C_j(N).
Other relative abelian inputs and global ramified horizontal fibres still require the genuine E73 arithmetic relation data. E23 is not declared solved.

Root independently read the complete proof and program, checked all seven frozen inputs and reran the copied source. Complete JSON and stdout agree byte for byte, with no omitted fields. Milne II Proposition1.22 and III Section4 Step2 were opened and their complete relevant proofs read. PASS.
